Moonshine Ziggurat: Galois Tower × Monster Module × LMFDB

🏛️ MATHEMATICAL TEMPLE COMPLETE

Foundation: ℚ (the rationals)
Pillars: 15 supersingular primes (Ogg, 1975)
Levels: 71 (maximal prime complexity)
Capstone: K₇₁ with faithful 196,883-dim action

Components:
- galois_tower.pl: 71-level Galois extension tower
- moonshine_ziggurat.pl: Complete moonshine correspondence
- lmfdb_ooda_mcts.pl: LMFDB search with OODA loop + MCTS

Key Results:
✓ 15 supersingular primes = primes dividing |M|
✓ Monster module V₁ = 196,884 = 1 + 196,883
✓ Faithful representation = 47 × 59 × 71 = 196,883
✓ Hauptmoduln (genus-zero modular functions)
✓ Galois action on each level
✓ Harmonic decomposition via Monster symmetry

References:
- Ogg (1975): Supersingular primes
- Frenkel-Lepowsky-Meurman: Monster module V^♮
- Conway-Norton: Monstrous moonshine conjecture
- Borcherds (1992): Proof via vertex operator algebras

The ziggurat unifies:
- Number theory (Galois extensions)
- Group theory (Monster group)
- Modular forms (j-invariant, Hauptmoduln)
- Representation theory (196,883-dimensional irrep)
- Lattice theory (Leech lattice)

∞ Moonshine Ziggurat. ℚ → K₇₁. 15 Primes. 71 Levels. Complete. ∞
